name: [❄FROZEN PEAKS + EVENT] Ability Wars Tower Defense
desc:
ALL EVENTS R BACK!!!!
FREEZE AND FROZEN PEAKS IS BACK!!!
NEW TOWER + INGAME CHANGELOG CHANGES SOON!

Welcome to the merged version of AWTD!

Ability Wars Tower Defense is inspired by Tower Defense Simulator and other fan games of them. Place down your abilities to attack your opponents and upgrade your towers as you get better at the game. Please expect bugs during this version of the game. 
Currently BETA.

Like and favorite to support us!!

Credits, shop, and settings can be viewed/configured in the main lobby. 

Join our communications server linked below for upcoming updates! 
Inspired by Ability Wars and the TDS Community
